create_Output_dataclass: create an Output dataclass to hold ATAC, RNA-seq, ChIP-seq, and splice site track data for a single prediction
filter_Output_by_strand: filter an Output object to keep only tracks on the positive, negative, or unspecified DNA strand
filter_Output_by_ontology: filter an Output object to keep only tracks associated with specific ontology terms
resize_Output_tracks: resize all track data in an Output object to a specified width in base pairs
concatenate_OutputMetadata: concatenate all track metadata from an OutputMetadata object into a single pandas DataFrame with output_type column
